newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to sell 14 to 16 bln francs of BTANs Thursd.
newsitem.headline: France to sell 14 to 16 bln francs of BTANs Thursd.

text.p: France is to offer between 14 and 16 billion francs of government bonds (BTANs) at its next scheduled auction on Thursday, the Treasury said on Tuesday.
The Treasury will offer the 4.50 percent October 1998 BTAN with a payment date of November 5, the statement said.
The Treasury also said it would offer the 5.50 percent October 2001 BTAN with a payment date of November 12.
